decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core substrate and packaging business that was still being marketed in 2024, it is likely above a minimum aspiration level and, given current growth and organisational slack, management would more likely continue than withdraw it.

Because it was newly launched in 2024 with prominent positioning and fits the firm's strategic move toward higher-value, technology-intensive semiconductor solutions, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it on the market.
